# Simple Group Generated By Prime Power Order Elements holds

Resolved true: the Kourovka Archive answers 18.52 "Yes, it is" (mod CFSG): by C. S. H. King (2017)
every finite (non-abelian) simple group is generated by an involution and an element of prime order;
a cyclic group of prime order is generated by one element of prime order. Source: E. I. Khukhro and
V. D. Mazurov (eds.), Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 21st issue,
arXiv:1401.0300v49 (2026), Archive of Solved Problems, Problem 18.52 (J. Krempa); resolution: C. S.
H. King, J. Algebra 478 (2017), 153-173, Kourovka Archive, Problem 18.52: Yes, it is (mod CFSG);
moreover every finite simple group is generated by an involution and an element of prime order,
https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v49.
